# Unicode Set v1.6.1 - Table of Contents

Implementation of Unicode Sets and Regexes for Elixir that can be used in
function guards, compiled patterns, nimble_parsec combinators
and regexes.

## Pages

- [Unicode Set](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [License](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/license.md)
- [Changelog](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Unicode.Regex](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Regex.md): Implements [Unicode regular expressions](http://unicode.org/reports/tr18/)
by transforming them into regular expressions supported by
the Elixir Regex module.
- [Unicode.Regex.Match](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Regex.Match.md)
- [Unicode.Set](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Set.md): 
- [Unicode.Set.Operation](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Set.Operation.md): Functions to operate on Unicode sets
- [Unicode.Set.Search](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Set.Search.md)

- Exceptions
  - [Unicode.Set.ParseError](https://unicode-set.hexdocs.pm/Unicode.Set.ParseError.md): Exception raised when an a Unicode Set cannot
be parsed
